baseline.name: Journal of Health Services Research & Policy
baseline.scope_notes: Fits health-services/systems and policy research, systematic/scoping/realist reviews, and conceptual or methodological work. Explain international relevance. Protocols are excluded; editorials are invited. Preprints are considered; supply the DOI, disclose them and do not update them during journal evaluation. Substantive GenAI use requires disclosure and output verification; the publisher prohibits specified content/data uses. Independent authors are eligible, subject to possible additional integrity documentation.

route.conditions: Use standard subscription publication; submission and publication are free. Optional Sage Choice OA and specifically requested print color cost extra; online color is free. Follow word limits: quantitative research 3,500; qualitative/mixed methods and reviews 6,000; conceptual/methodological articles 4,000. Limits are editorial requirements, not a purchased overlength option.
route.other_mandatory_costs: No compulsory membership, registration, page or overlength payment is stated for manuscripts within the article limits; journal policy expressly excludes submission and publication fees.

fee_evidence.note: The journal expressly makes both submission and publication free and separates optional open access and print color.

baseline.audit_note: Read official author criteria and homepage. The homepage advertises decision speed without a reporting period; this is not acceptance-rate evidence. Sage metrics endpoints were inaccessible. Official issue front matter found in search reports a 2023 impact factor, which is historical and was not substituted for a current verified value. baseline.name: Journal of Information Science
baseline.scope_notes: Information science and knowledge management offer a route for computational analyses of scholarly information, research-information organization, retrieval and communication when there is a clear information-science contribution. Methods and algorithms can accompany a research article; this is not a standalone software-deposit venue. Average article length is 5,000–7,500 words, with brief communications up to 1,500. Preprints are accepted, with no updates during review and a link to the published version after acceptance. The linked Sage AI policy distinguishes assistive editing from generative research/content uses requiring disclosure and prohibits specified uses; human authors remain accountable.

route.conditions: Current instructions explicitly exclude submission and publication fees for the ordinary subscription route.
